errorRoleAssignMessage:
Failed to assign the verified/unverified role to a user.

**Check, in this order:**
• **Role order** — the bot's own role must sit **above** every role it hands out (Server Settings → Roles, drag the bot's role up). Discord enforces this and no permission overrides it.
• **Manage Roles** — the bot needs this permission.
• **The roles still exist** and are not managed by another bot/integration (those can never be assigned).

Run `/status` for a live check of all three.
[See a picture of the correct role order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lkaesberg/EmailBot/main/images/bothierarchy.png)

• Restrict verification to a specific list of addresses with `/emaillist upload`

Run `/status` to check the current configuration.

onboardingTitle: 👋 EmailVerify is ready — about a minute to set up
onboardingWhat: EmailVerify lets members prove they own an email address — a university, school, or company address — before they get a role here. Useful for keeping a server to verified students, staff, or customers.
onboardingSteps:
**The bot stays inactive until it is set up:**

**1.** Run `/setup` and pick the role verified members should receive
**2.** Choose which email domains count as valid (for example `uni-goettingen.de`)
**3.** Pick the channel where the verification button goes

Then run `/button` in that channel. Members click it, get a code by email, and are verified automatically.

permIssueTitle: EmailVerify cannot work with its current permissions
permIssueIntro: A self-check found problems that will make verification fail. Nothing here is caused by a member — an admin has to fix it once.
permFixPerms:
Pick **one**:
• **Re-invite the bot** with the button below — this grants everything at once, keeps every setting, and does not remove the bot.
• Or open **Server Settings → Roles → %VAR%** and enable the permissions listed above by hand.
permReasonHierarchy: sits **above** the bot's own role in the role list
permReasonManaged: belongs to another bot, an integration, or Nitro boosting — **no bot can ever assign it**, pick a different role
permReasonEveryone: is the `@everyone` role, which cannot be assigned to anyone — remove it from the configuration
permFieldHowToFixHierarchy: How to fix the role order
permHierarchyFix:
Discord only lets a bot hand out roles that sit **below** its own highest role. No permission can override this — the roles have to be reordered.

**1.** Open **Server Settings → Roles**
**2.** Drag %VAR% (the bot's role) **above** every role listed above
**3.** Done — nothing needs to be re-run

[See a picture of the correct order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lkaesberg/EmailBot/main/images/bothierarchy.png)

setupCommandDescription: Guided setup: verified role (can create it for you), email domains, and the verification channel
setupStep1Body:
Which role should every verified member receive?

• **Create one for me** — a new **%VAR%** role. The bot can always hand out a role it created, so there is nothing to fix in the role order.
• **Or pick existing roles** from the menu (1–5).

*You can refine this later with `/role` and `/domainrole` (per-domain roles).*
setupNoUsableRoles: ❌ None of the selected roles can be used (@everyone and bot-managed roles are not assignable). Please pick different roles.
setupRoleCreateFailed:
❌ Creating the role failed: %VAR%
You can create it yourself and pick it from the menu instead.
setupStep2Existing: Unverified role already set: %VAR% (given to new members on join: **%VAR%**). Change it later with `/role unverified` and `/settings auto-unverified`.
setupStep2Offer:
Should new members get an **%VAR%** role until they verify? You can then hide your channels from that role.

*Optional — most servers skip it: hiding channels from @everyone and showing them to the verified role does the same, and also covers members who joined before today. The unverified role only reaches members who join from now on.*
setupCreateUnverifiedButton: Create "%VAR%" & give it to new members
setupRoleBothKinds: ❌ %VAR% is already a verified role, so it can't also be the unverified role. Skip this step or set one later with `/role unverified`.
setupUnverifiedSaved: Unverified role: %VAR%, given to new members when they join.
setupStep3Body:
Should verification be limited to specific email domains?
• **Restrict domains** — e.g. only `@company.com` or `@*.edu` addresses
• **Allow any email** — every valid address can verify
setupDomainsModalHeader:
**Which email domains may verify?**
Use `*` as a wildcard — `@*.edu` matches any .edu address.
setupNoValidDomains: ❌ No valid domains found. Formats: `@gmail.com`, `gmail.com`, or wildcards like `@*.edu` — comma-separated. Click **Restrict domains** to try again.
setupAnyEmailNote: Allowing **any email address** to verify (you can restrict later with `/domain add`).
setupStep4Body: Pick the channel where the verification message (with the **Verify** button) should be posted. Members click it to start verifying.
setupChannelNoPerms: ⚠️ I can't send messages in %VAR%. Give me **View Channel** and **Send Messages** there, or pick another channel.
setupChannelPostFailed: ⚠️ Posting in %VAR% failed. Check my permissions there or pick another channel.
setupLockTitle: **🔒 One thing left: hide your channels until members verify.**
setupLockBody: A role doesn't hide anything by itself. For each members-only category or channel: **Edit → Permissions**, turn **View Channel** off for `@everyone` and on for %VAR%. Keep %VAR% visible to everyone.
setupNextSteps:
**Recommended next steps:**
• `/status` — check the full configuration
• `/testmail` — send yourself a test email to confirm delivery
• `/settings auto-verify` — DM new members a verification prompt
• `/settings log-channel` — log verifications for your mods
• `/blacklist add` — block disposable-email patterns
helpCommandDescription: Learn how to set up and use the email verification bot
helpSourceBody:
This bot is free software under the [GNU AGPL v3.0 or later](%VAR%). The complete corresponding source code is available at %VAR%
*If you run a modified version as a service, you must offer its source to your users.*
helpMemberDescription: This server uses email verification to grant access. Here is what you can do.
helpMemberCommandsBody:
`/verify` - Start the email verification process
`/vote` - Vote for the bot and give this server free bonus emails
`/data delete-user` - Delete your verification data
helpHowBody:
**1.** Start with `/verify` or the verification button
**2.** Enter your email address in the popup
**3.** Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the code
**4.** Enter the code to receive your roles
helpMemberFooter: Server admins see setup instructions here • getemailverified.com
helpAdminDescription: Follow these steps to set up email verification for your server.
helpNewBody: Run **`/setup`** — a guided wizard that creates (or picks) the verified role, sets the email domains, and posts the verification message for you. Then `/testmail` to confirm delivery.
helpManualBody:
**1.** `/role add <role>` - Add a default role for verified users
**2.** `/domain add <domains>` - Add allowed email domains
**3.** `/button <channel>` - Create verification embed
**4.** `/status` - Verify everything is configured
helpRolesBody:
`/role add` - Add a default role (given to all verified users)
`/role remove` - Remove a default role
`/role list` - View all default roles
`/role unverified` - Set/view optional role for unverified members
helpDomainRolesBody:
`/domainrole add` - Assign roles for specific email domains
`/domainrole remove` - Remove a role from a domain
`/domainrole list` - View all domain-role mappings
`/domainrole clear` - Remove all roles for a domain
*Users get domain roles + default roles on verification*
helpDomainsBody:
`/domain add` - Add allowed domains (use `*` wildcard, e.g. `@*.edu`)
`/domain remove` - Remove allowed domains
`/domain list` - View all allowed domains
`/domain clear` - Remove all allowed domains
helpBlacklistBody:
`/blacklist add` - Block patterns (use `*` wildcard, e.g. `*@tempmail.*`)
`/blacklist remove` - Unblock patterns
`/blacklist list` - View all blacklisted entries
`/blacklist clear` - Remove all blacklist entries
helpSettingsBody:
`/settings language` - Change bot language
`/settings log-channel` - Set verification log channel
`/settings verify-message` - Custom text in the verification form

helpPremiumBody:
`/premium status` - View your plan, available upgrades, and buy buttons
`/premium redeem` - Apply purchased credits or CSV unlock to this server
`/vote` - Free: each member vote adds bonus emails to this month's quota
`/emaillist`, `/export`, `/api` - Allowed-email list, CSV export and API (Pro or CSV unlock)
**Standard** - Unlimited verifications + premium ZeptoMail delivery
**Pro** - Standard + CSV import & export + API
**Credit packs** - One-time top-up of 100 / 500 / 2000 verifications
**CSV unlock** - One-time CSV features without a subscription
**Pay-per-send ZeptoMail** - `/settings mail-mode zeptomail` routes every mail through ZeptoMail at 1 credit each; auto-disables when credits hit 0
